body:
**Filing gate ③: a task the maintainer set.** This carries out ruling **3 C** on #25040 (batch #381 item 3, 「其他同意」, `6308462370`). Split by triage per that ruling's state line. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Disclosure:** the #9387 ruling (`5323310017`) applies. ⛔ No probe string or payload goes on this card, its PR or any comment.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:services` seat (`plugin-email` and the outlet owners), in one PR or a short serial set.

## The rule (from the ruling)

- **No server-side stripping or refusal of markup in text fields.** A user's display name may contain any characters.
- **Every outlet that renders a text field into HTML escapes by context:** the mail template engine by default, HTML exports and integration payloads. A **pin on the outlet list** keeps a new outlet from escaping the rule.
- **In the same work:** measure whether `sys_user.name`'s declared `maxLength: 255` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:776–781`) is enforced at the write seam. If it is not, bring it under #11875's rule.

## Done when

- The outlet list is enumerated from the code (mail templates, HTML export, integration payload builders), and each entry escapes by context, with a pin per entry and one pin on the list itself.
- `sys_user.name`'s length reading is recorded, and the seam enforces it if it did not.
- Pins are named by the rule and ablation-verified.
